title: Image Tag Input
description: Stops deploys from pulling the wrong container by reading the reference back the way Docker resolves it (implied docker.io/library/ and :latest shown), flagging :latest or no tag in production, tags that move, typo'd or frozen registries, private images that fall back to Docker Hub, malformed digests and arch-specific tags that won't run on the target, with one-tap fixes including pinning a digest.
